_meta.purpose: Machine-readable source of truth for AX offerings. The website derives names, prices, durations and one-liners from this file. Do not hardcode these values in templates — use the build to inject them.
_meta.phase_5_note: Site now derives from this file via {{offering:KEY.field}} tokens (Phase 5, #57). Display names renamed; URL slugs/keys deliberately kept unchanged (no redirects). Check #10 enforces no drift.
_meta.vat: All prices quoted +VAT (exclusive) — UK B2B norm; VAT-registered clients reclaim it. One site-wide footnote covers international (B2B place-of-supply: non-UK businesses not charged UK VAT). Decided 2026-06-14.
_meta.public_headline: from £3,500 +VAT (the cohort place — lowest honest entry). Decided 2026-06-14.
_meta.standalone_workshop: RETIRED 2026-06-14 — not a listed offering. Workshops live inside Phase 0 + Leadership Team AI Activation; standalone facilitated sessions = the Talks & Events 'Leadership Offsite' format. One-offs handled ad hoc on request.
_meta.guarantee: "No value, no payment" — clarified 2026-06-14 (Andy): lead with the strong principle, NO caveats/legal-speak up front. Applies across ALL coaching, training and activation/enablement (NOT one-off Talks & Events/keynotes). Company Enablement/Phase 0: after session 1, you decide — not worth it, pay nothing. Coaching (all 3 formats): two full sessions + keep the resources, cancel before the third for a full refund. Beyond that: no lock-in, cycle/format at a time. Keep prominent.
_meta.ip_and_data: What the client builds is theirs. AX frameworks/tools shared are theirs to use freely in business/personal life, but not to resell or run as a competing service. 1:1 confidential. NDAs/DPAs handled directly, not detailed on the site. Decided 2026-06-14.
_meta.procurement: No discounting (prices move up, not down). Can work within a required formal process (done before, incl. a global financial consulting firm); heavier process = more scope = higher price. Light touch on site.
